title: Senior AI Enginner
description: Job title: Senior AI Engineer (LLM, RAG & Voice AI) Company: Vector & Voice AI Private Limited Location: Remote for now; moving to Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram (on-site) once our office is set up Type: Full-time Salary: Competitive, decided after the interview based on experience and skills About us Vector & Voice AI is a Thiruvananthapuram-based company building practical AI products for real businesses, from AI agents and document intelligence to voice assistants and healthcare tools. We’re a small, fast-moving team, and our sister company, Vector & Voice Creative Agency, gives us a steady flow of real client problems to solve. What you’ll do Design and build production LLM applications: RAG pipelines, AI agents and tool-calling workflows Build voice AI features (speech-to-text, text-to-speech, real-time voice agents) for our products Choose the right models, vector databases and architecture for each project, and make it scale Integrate AI into web and mobile apps alongside our full-stack team Evaluate and improve quality: accuracy, latency, cost and hallucination control Grow into leading our AI engineering team as we expand What we’re looking for 2+ years building real AI/LLM applications, not just tutorials Strong Python, with experience in FastAPI or Django Hands-on with LangChain/LangGraph or similar, embeddings and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector) Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or open-source LLM APIs Comfortable deploying with Docker and a cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure) Able to own a feature end to end and explain technical choices clearly Willing to work from Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram once we move on-site Good to have Voice AI experience (Whisper, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, LiveKit, Twilio or similar) MCP servers, multi-agent systems, or LLM evaluation frameworks Fine-tuning experience (LoRA/QLoRA) Experience leading or mentoring developers Why join us Build AI products that real customers use, not just demos A direct line to the founder and real say in technical direction A clear path to lead the AI team Start remote, then join our team at Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram To apply: send your résumé along with your GitHub or a short note on the best AI system you’ve built and your role in it. Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month Benefits: Paid sick time Application Question(s): Now remote and once our office got setup, move into the office. Experience: AI/LLM development: 2 years (Preferred) Language: Malayalam (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sasthamangalam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala
